objective: Audit all existing connectors and identify immediately usable sources for ~1,000 company pilot

sources.notes: SEC EDGAR public API (efts.sec.gov and data.sec.gov). Requires User-Agent header. Rate limit: 10 req/sec. Company tickers.json gives all registered companies. Submissions API gives SIC codes and state. country derived deterministically for records with a valid US state/territory code (United States); foreign/unmapped jurisdictions left unknown. Websites not provided by SEC.
Bulk CSV downloads available at download.companieshouse.gov.uk. Files are large (100MB+ for full dataset). Would need manual download and selective import. Free and open data.
sources.expected_file_format: CSV with columns: CompanyNumber, CompanyName, CompanyStatus, CountryOfOrigin, IncorporationDate, SICCode_1, etc.

sources.notes: Community-maintained dataset on data.world. Requires free data.world account for download. Contains YC-backed open source startups with websites. High quality but limited to ~1000 companies.
sources.expected_file_format: CSV with columns: Company, Website, Description, Region, Industry, CB_URL, etc.

sources.notes: Catch-all connector for any manually downloaded CSV. Can ingest any startup data CSV with flexible column mapping. Used for Crunchbase exports, PitchBook exports, Kaggle datasets, etc.

recommended_pilot_strategy.rationale: Immediately usable, no API key required, public data, 7000+ companies available. Provides verified company names, CIKs, SIC codes, and state of incorporation.
recommended_pilot_strategy.expected_yield: ~1000 tech companies from SEC EDGAR with verified metadata
recommended_pilot_strategy.limitations: Website field will be empty for SEC EDGAR companies (SEC does not publish company websites). Quality report will flag these as missing_required_field.

pilot_result.country_coverage_country_derived: US states -> United States; foreign jurisdictions left unknown
pilot_result.notes: 881 operating companies within the 500-1,000 pilot target. Reaching ~1,000 requires a supplementary source (website enrichment via YC OSS / Companies House) or a non-overlapping second SEC batch.

scaling_recommendations: For 10,000+ companies: combine SEC EDGAR + Companies House + YC OSS + Crunchbase exports
Obtain data.world account for YC OSS dataset (free, immediate 1000 companies with websites)
Download Companies House bulk CSV for UK company coverage
Consider Crunchbase free tier or Kaggle datasets for enrichment
Website enrichment could be done via company CIK → SEC filing → website lookup (slower but automated)
